full_text_zh:
[P1] 蜡笔小黑
（日）中屋美和 著 朱自强 译
10支 蜡笔小朋友 姓名

[P3] 蜡笔小黑
（日）中屋美和 著 朱自强 译
有一盒没有用过的蜡笔。
“太没意思了，真让人心烦。”
新星出版社 NEW STAR PRESS

[P4] 有一天，黄蜡笔跳了出来。
“一直闲待着，我都烦透了。”
说着，他从桌子上蹦蹦地跑走了……

[P5] 他发现了一张图画纸。

“哇！真大，真白啊！”
黄蜡笔不由得……

[P6] 咕噜咕噜，在纸上面画起了飞舞的蝴蝶。
“这纸画起来多舒服啊！感觉太好了。”
黄蜡笔高兴极了。
“对了，有了蝴蝶，就得有花。”
于是，黄蜡笔……

[P7] 叫来了红蜡笔和粉蜡笔。
看到大大的图画纸，红蜡笔和粉蜡笔高兴极了。
咕唧咕唧，红蜡笔画了郁金香。
刺溜刺溜，粉蜡笔画了波斯菊。
“对了，有了花，就得有叶子。”
于是，粉蜡笔……

[P8] 叫来了绿蜡笔和浅绿蜡笔。
看到大大的图画纸，绿蜡笔和浅绿蜡笔也高兴极了。
吧嗒吧嗒，浅绿蜡笔为波斯菊画上了叶子。
刷啦刷啦，绿蜡笔为郁金香画上了叶子。
“对了，花儿要种在大地上。”
“顺便把树也种上吧。”
于是，浅绿蜡笔……

[P9] 叫来了茶色蜡笔和土黄蜡笔。
看到大大的图画纸，
茶色蜡笔和土黄蜡笔也高兴极了。
沙沙沙，茶色蜡笔画出了地面。
嘎吱嘎吱，土黄蜡笔画出了树。
“对了，不能没有蓝天哪！”
“还要有飘浮的云朵。”

[P10] 茶色蜡笔叫来了蓝蜡笔和浅蓝蜡笔。
看到大大的图画纸，蓝蜡笔和浅蓝蜡笔高兴极了。
咯吱咯吱，蓝蜡笔画出了蓝天。
哐哐哐，浅蓝蜡笔勾画出了轻柔的白云。
“我们的画画好了！”
蜡笔们对自己的第一张画非常满意。

[P11] 这时，黑蜡笔走了过来，他问道：
“喂，我呢？我在哪里画好呢？”
大家说：
“小黑，现在用不到你。”
“这么好看的画，弄黑了可不行……”
大家都不让黑蜡笔一起来画画。

[P12] “再画一些吧。”
“再多画一些。”
大家又开始高兴地画了起来。
“为什么我是这种颜色呢……”
黑蜡笔孤零零地坐在那里。
这时，铅笔哥哥过来安慰他：
“打起精神来，小黑！”

[P13] 突然，蜡笔们吵了起来。
“别在我画好的上面画！"
“你也别在我画好的上面画！"
因为大家只顾一个劲儿地画，纸上变得乱七八糟。
这时，铅笔哥哥悄悄地对黑蜡笔说了些什么，黑蜡笔听了很吃惊。

[P14] 黑蜡笔突然在大家画的画上，
吱吱吱地用力涂抹起来。

[P15] 涂啊，涂啊，蜡笔尖都涂平了。
大家的画被涂得漆黑一片。

[P16] 大家生气地说：
“小黑！你都干了些什么！"
“我们的画全都被你弄黑了！"
这时，铅笔哥哥微笑着说：
“嘿，你们都来看我的！"
他在画上哧哧哧地划动着笔尖，
黑颜色随着笔尖的移动被刮了下去……

[P17] 转眼之间，夜空中升起了
好几朵大大的烟花。
“我们的画变成了烟花！”

[P18] “铅笔哥哥，谢谢你。”
现在，蜡笔们开心极了！
“别谢我，要谢就谢谢小黑吧。
有了小黑，才有了烟花。”

[P19] 蜡笔们围在小黑的旁边，纷纷说：
“小黑，刚才真是对不起。”
“你的黑颜色可真了不起啊。”
full_text_en:
[P1] Crayon Kuro
By Miwa Nakaya (Japan), translated by Zhu Ziqiang
10 pieces Crayon Friends Name

[P3] Crayon Shin-chan
By Mika Nakaya (Japan), translated by Zhu Ziqiang
There was a box of unused crayons.
"This is so boring, it's really annoying."
New Star Press

[P4] One day, the yellow crayon jumped out.
"Being idle all the time, I'm so bored!"
Saying that, he bounced away from the table...

[P5] He found a sheet of drawing paper.

"Wow! So big, so white!"
The yellow crayon couldn't help but...

[P6] Gurgle gurgle, it drew fluttering butterflies on the paper.
"Drawing on this paper feels so comfortable! It's wonderful!"
The yellow crayon was overjoyed.
"Ah, if there are butterflies, there must be flowers."
So, the yellow crayon...

[P7] Called over the red crayon and the pink crayon.
Seeing the big drawing paper, the red crayon and the pink crayon were thrilled.
Gurgle gurgle, the red crayon drew a tulip.
Slick slick, the pink crayon drew a chrysanthemum.
"Right, if we have flowers, we must have leaves."
So, the pink crayon……

[P8] They called for the green crayon and the light green crayon.
Seeing the big drawing paper, the green crayon and the light green crayon were thrilled.
Tap tap, the light green crayon drew leaves on the chrysanthemums.
Brush brush, the green crayon drew leaves on the tulips.
"Oh, the flowers need to be planted on the ground."
"Let’s draw a tree too."
So, the light green crayon...

[P9] They called for the brown crayon and the tan crayon.
Seeing the big drawing paper,
the brown crayon and the tan crayon were thrilled too.
Scratch scratch, the brown crayon drew the ground.
Crunch crunch, the tan crayon drew the tree.
"Oh right, we can't forget the blue sky!"
"And floating clouds too."

[P10] The brown crayon called over the blue crayon and the light blue crayon.
Seeing the big drawing paper, the blue crayon and the light blue crayon were very excited.
Crunch crunch, the blue crayon drew the blue sky.
Clang clang, the light blue crayon drew the soft white clouds.
“Our drawing is done!”
The crayons were very pleased with their first picture.

[P11] At this moment, the black crayon walked over and asked:
"Hey, what about me? Where should I draw?"
The others said:
"Little Black, we don't need you right now."
"This beautiful picture, we can't ruin it by making it black..."
Everyone refused to let the black crayon join in the drawing.

[P12] "Let's draw some more."
"Draw even more!"
Everyone started drawing happily again.
"Why am I this color...?"
The black crayon sat there all alone.
At that moment, the pencil brother came over to comfort him:
"Cheer up, little Black!"

[P13] Suddenly, the crayons started arguing.
"Don't draw on top of my drawing!"
"You shouldn't draw on top of my drawing either!"
Because everyone was just drawing without thinking, the paper became a mess.
At this moment, the pencil brother quietly said something to the black crayon, and the black crayon was very surprised.

[P14] The black crayon suddenly started scribbling on everyone's drawing,
scratching and rubbing hard.

[P15] Color, color, the crayon tips are all worn flat.
The everyone's drawing has been colored black.

[P16] Everyone said angrily:
"Little Black! What have you done!"
"Our painting has all been ruined by you!"
At this moment, the pencil brother smiled and said:
"Hey, come and see mine!"
He moved his pen tip back and forth on the painting,
and the black color was scraped away as the tip moved...

[P17] In the blink of an eye, several big fireworks rose into the night sky.
“Our drawing has turned into fireworks!”

[P18] "Pencil Brother, thank you."
Now, the crayons are overjoyed!
"Don't thank me, thank Little Black instead.
It was only because of Little Black that we had fireworks."

[P19] The crayons gathered around Xiao Hei and said:
"Xiao Hei, we're really sorry about earlier."
"Your black color is truly amazing!"
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页是绘本《蜡笔小黑》的封面，展示了装有十支拟人化蜡笔的盒子，其中一支黑色蜡笔表情低落，其他蜡笔表情各异，背景为木质桌面。
[P2] 本页为纯黄色背景，无文字或图像内容，可能是绘本的内页分隔页或空白页。
[P3] 本页展示了绘本《蜡笔小黑》的封面，一盒拟人化的蜡笔整齐排列，其中一支黄色蜡笔跳出盒子，表情不耐烦，下方文字说明它们从未被使用过，感到无聊和烦躁。
[P4] 黄蜡笔因感到无聊而跳出盒子，蹦蹦跳跳地跑开了，其他蜡笔在盒中看着它。
[P5] 黄蜡笔在木质桌面上发现了一张空白的图画纸，感到惊喜并发出感叹。
[P6] 黄蜡笔在纸上画出蝴蝶，感到非常开心，并决定接下来要画花。
[P7] 黄蜡笔叫来红蜡笔和粉蜡笔一起画画，红蜡笔画了郁金香，粉蜡笔画了波斯菊，并计划画叶子，画面展示了它们在纸上画出的花朵和叶子。
[P8] 黄蜡笔叫来绿蜡笔和浅绿蜡笔一起画画，它们为画好的花朵添加了叶子，并计划画大地和树，画面展示了花朵和叶子的完成状态。
[P9] 黄蜡笔叫来茶色和土黄蜡笔，它们一起在图画纸上画出地面和树，并讨论要添加蓝天和云朵。
[P10] 茶色蜡笔叫来蓝蜡笔和浅蓝蜡笔，它们一起画出了蓝天和白云，完成第一幅画后，蜡笔们对自己的作品感到非常满意。
[P11] 黑蜡笔想加入画画，但其他蜡笔认为画作会因此被弄黑，拒绝了它，黑蜡笔感到失落。
[P12] 黑蜡笔因被排斥而感到失落，铅笔哥哥前来安慰它，鼓励它打起精神。画面右侧展示了蜡笔们在纸上画出的完整花园场景。
[P13] 蜡笔们因争抢画画位置而争吵，导致画面混乱；铅笔哥哥悄悄对黑蜡笔说了话，黑蜡笔感到吃惊。
[P14] 黑蜡笔突然在大家共同完成的画作上用力涂抹，画面变得混乱，其他蜡笔们站在一旁，显得惊讶或不知所措。
[P15] 黑蜡笔在大家共同完成的画作上用力涂抹，导致画面被涂成一片漆黑，其他蜡笔们站在一旁，显得惊讶或不知所措。
[P16] 黑蜡笔将画作涂黑后，其他蜡笔生气指责，铅笔哥哥则微笑着用笔尖刮去黑色，展示修复画作的过程。
[P17] 画面中，原本被涂黑的画作在铅笔哥哥的修复后，化作了夜空中绚烂的烟花，蜡笔们惊喜地发现他们的画变成了烟花。
[P18] 蜡笔们感谢铅笔哥哥修复了画作，铅笔哥哥却将功劳归于被排斥的黑蜡笔，指出正是因为黑蜡笔的涂抹才有了烟花，黑蜡笔独自站在一旁，神情复杂。
[P19] 蜡笔们围在黑蜡笔身边，向它道歉并称赞它的黑色非常了不起，表现出对黑蜡笔的认可和感激。
[P20] 本页为纯黄色背景，无任何文字或图画内容，可能是绘本的过渡页或留白页。
[P21] 本页为纯黄色木纹背景，中央有一支拟人化的黑蜡笔，它正画出一条弯曲的黑色线条，表情平静，画面简洁，可能象征黑蜡笔的自我表达或新开始。
